# Moira's Wager

*Moira wants to prove to Torva that she can hunt. Defeat 60 Sea Newts, race her from the foot of the stairs to the head of the Long Stair, then carry her case to Torva on the Forest Shore.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Moira](../npcs/moira_watch.md) |
| Level | 36 |

## Objectives

1. Defeat 60 [Sea Newt](../monsters/sea_newt.md)
2. Reach the foot of the stairs in [Goa Harbour](../maps/goa_harbour.md)
3. Reach the head of the Long Stair in [Goa Harbour](../maps/goa_harbour.md)
4. Talk to [Torva](../npcs/torva_hunter.md)

## Rewards

- 12,000 EXP
- 1,500 mesos
- [Gap Inn Stew](../items/gap_inn_stew.md) x10
- +30 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Moira](../npcs/moira_watch.md)
